title: The Letter to the Colossians
lead: A short letter from prison that names Paul (with Timothy) as its sender, to the church at Colossae in the Lycus valley; its authorship is debated. It answers a rival 'philosophy' with the claim that all the fullness of God lives in Christ, the image of the unseen God, and draws from it a new life of love and an ordered household. It shares much wording with Ephesians and many names with Philemon.
